sourceFile: 04. TIU L5S3-01 - Report test material MG NG difference color - date 2026.04.01_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has valid Normal vs Test structure but needs correction of the second AI NG calculation and context grouping before use.
issues: Second AI result uses 10/152 instead of total NG 38/152 and misses normal total NG 8/168.
Changed factor should specify MG color-difference test material lot versus normal, not generic Normal vs Test.
AI-machine reset is secondary test-round context and should be preserved.
Decision rows are not cited, so final acceptance/rejection context is incomplete.
Some outcome labels are too broad for multi-column inspection results.
correctionPlan: Revise changed factor to MG color-difference material lot compared with normal material.
Add subgroup context for initial test and after AI/align machine setting.
Correct pair-2 subresult to test 38/152=25% and normal 8/168=4.76%, unless metric is explicitly limited to one NG subtype.
Cite rows for section headings, setting note, result comments, and decision.
Clarify each outcome metric as AI bond MG, MG+Yoke, vision, decap/drop, and function as applicable.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist but are insufficient for final evidence because key context and decision rows are omitted.
